ANON_KEY.description: Public anon JWT. References the auth service's ANON_KEY so client-side storage calls are authenticated.

SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Server-side full-access key. References the auth service's SERVICE_ROLE_KEY for admin storage operations.

PGRST_JWT_SECRET.description: HS256 secret for JWT verification. References the auth service's JWT_SECRET.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string for storage API. Uses private networking and references postgres service vars.

FILE_SIZE_LIMIT.description: Maximum file upload size in bytes (52428800 = 50 MB). Increase for larger file support.

STORAGE_BACKEND.description: Storage backend type. 's3' uses MinIO (S3-compatible). 'file' uses local disk (not recommended for Railway).

FILE_STORAGE_BACKEND_PATH.description: Temporary path for file processing before upload to S3.

GLOBAL_S3_BUCKET.description: Default S3 bucket name. The bucket is created automatically on first storage API startup if it does not exist.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: S3 access key. References the minio service's MINIO_ROOT_USER.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: S3 secret key. References the minio service's MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD (auto-generated).

AWS_REGION.description: AWS region for S3. MinIO ignores this but the storage API requires a non-empty value.

REGION.description: Region for the storage API. Must match AWS_REGION.

AWS_S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint URL. Points to MinIO via Railway private networking on port 8080 (Railway-injected PORT).

AWS_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Force path-style S3 addressing. Required for MinIO compatibility (not using virtual-host-style).

ENABLE_IMAGE_TRANSFORMATION.description: Enable image transformation (resize, optimize). Set to false to save RAM on Railway.
